title: America America
desc: Childhood friends, Surya, Shashank and Bhoomi decide to focus on their career after graduating. Later, Shashank and Bhoomi get married but fate has different plans for them.

title: Venkata in Sankata
desc: When a senior police officer's credits are always taken by his junior, he seeks an astrologer's advice to turn his fortunes.

title: Pushpaka Vimana
desc: Kamal, jobless and dreaming of riches, swaps places with a drunk industrialist. He moves into the posh hotel 'Pushpak' and finds love and adventure in his new life.

title: Martin
desc: In a twist of fate, a man trying to defend his motherland encounters his doppelgänger, who turns out to be his deadliest foe to date.

title: Inspector Vijay
desc: Vijay, an honest police officer, meets Samyukta at a cafe and falls in love with her. However, his life changes when he witnesses a kidnapping and ends up helping a lonely woman, Lavanya.

title: Thayige Thakka Maga
desc: Parvathi, a lawyer, and her son, Mohandas, lead a righteous life. However, they find themselves in danger after crossing paths with the son of a corrupt politician.
